about: The unchanged @openrouter/sdk (Substrate's vibecode pins ^1.3.19) sends one chat completion with the key the World's credential door issues as OPENROUTER_API_KEY, on z-ai/glm-5.2 (Volter Editor's default coding model), and asserts its text and model.

retention.none: A chat completion stores nothing a client reads back: OpenRouter's key metadata (GET /key) is the one read the demanded apps make after it, and the twin keeps a key's usage at 0 because it charges nothing (src/semantics/key.ts).
